name: pocotoko
description: Model and effort rules, a chat-length meter and a hand-off note skill.

soft_tokens.title: Soft warning size
soft_tokens.description: Chat size, in tokens, at which the first warning appears. A whole number of at least 10000.

hard_tokens.title: Hard warning size
hard_tokens.description: Chat size, in tokens, at which the start-a-new-session warning appears and a hand-off note is requested. A whole number of at least 20000, above the soft size.

repeat_every_tokens.title: Repeat warning step
repeat_every_tokens.description: Past the hard size, warn again every this many tokens. 0 means warn once.

handoff_note.title: Ask for a hand-off note
handoff_note.description: At the hard size, ask Claude to write a hand-off note into a file the kit creates.

handoff_dir.title: Hand-off folder
handoff_dir.description: Absolute path of an existing folder for hand-off notes, outside any project and any git work tree. Empty uses the kit's own default folder.

routing_rules_at_start.title: Inject routing rules at start
routing_rules_at_start.description: Add the short model and effort rules block to each new session.
